headline: US says it plans extra tariffs of 10% or more for most trading partners after forced labor probe
summary: The US Trade Representative said the Trump administration is proposing tariffs of 10% or more on dozens of major trading partners. The proposal follows a probe into alleged forced labor.
why: Tariffs raise the cost of imports and can shift global trade flows, affecting exporters, importers, and multinational supply chains. The US is the world's largest importer.
why_moved: A proposal for broad new tariffs on dozens of major trading partners raises expectations of higher import costs and retaliation risk for trade-exposed companies.
